title: Issue Monitor silently drops open Issues
intent: Focused tests queued in verify.run behind the host verification lease
progress_summary: Root cause: 180 of 232 open Issues held by complete_live_absence closure records tied at their last updated_at; the reopen gate failed closed on ties in the scan transition and in the cross-process merge. Fix written: tie reopens a non-explicit closure, merge ties fall to the generation fence, REST issue list pages by created order, issue.monitor.status gains closure_held. Tests written; awaiting lease to run.
